summary: PR 7484 made CI initialize Pester from the Avm.Authoring configuration before Pester can autoload another version. It merged on 2026-10-07 after one approval.
proposed: The body says VMSS, Log Analytics workspace and App Configuration static-validation jobs in one automatic run loaded Pester 5.9.0, then failed nested metadata validation because released Avm.Authoring 0.21.0 selected 5.7.1.
changed: The body adds one shared initializer called from module static validation, the standalone metadata workflow, Test-ModuleLocally (PesterTest and PesterTestRecurse) and Test-CI. It requires Avm.Authoring 0.21.0 or later, resolves the manifest with Get-AvmTool, and runs Install-AvmTool -Name Pester only when the prerequisite is missing.
shipped: Merged 2026-10-07 as commit d4731c8, changing .github actions and workflows, utilities/pipelines, utilities/tests and utilities/tools. The slice records no module file deltas.
